title: About the Authentication Service User Dashboard

blocks.text: The Authentication Service user dashboard provides a comprehensive view of all users managed from Authentication Service, their authentication status, and user management activities in the Zscaler Admin Console.
The dashboard provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View the total number of users managed from Authentication Service.
Obtain visibility into the user authentication status.
View the service entitlements assigned to users.

blocks.text: On the Dashboard page (Administration > Authentication > Overview), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View the overview of users. You can see:
Total Users: The total number of users that are managed from Authentication Service.
IdP Users: The number of registered and guest users accessing Zscaler service through Authentication Service.
Hosted Users: The number of registered and guest users hosted on Authentication Service.
Registered domain users: Users whose login IDs is created using the registered organization's domain (e.g., acme.zslogin.net).
Guest domain users: Users whose login IDs is created using guest domains.
To view the list of registered and guest domains, from the navigation menu, go to Administration > Authentication > Domains.
Service Entitlements: The number of users assigned to different Zscaler services. To learn more, see About Service Entitlements.
The Service Entitlements widget is visible only when the service entitlement is enabled for your tenant.
Select the duration between 1 and 90 days for which you want to view the data.

View the authentication status (Success or Failure) of hosted users and external IdP users. The graph depicts the total number of users that logged in to Zscaler Admin Console using a specific authentication method along with the date and time of authentication attempt.
External IdP is applicable only to Zscaler services that are not migrated to Experience Center.
View the statistics for successful user management activities (Created, Updated, and Deleted) on a specific date and time.
View the statistics for failed user management activities (Created, Updated, and Deleted) on a specific date and time.
